title: Vertical product ad (Reels / TikTok)
description: Short 9:16 product video with a hook in the first second, a clear beat structure and an end card, for text-to-video models.

variables.name: product
variables.description: The product and its key visual trait
variables.example: a translucent orange insulated water bottle

variables.name: setting
variables.example: a sunny rooftop gym at golden hour

variables.name: key_moment
variables.description: The single action that shows the benefit
variables.example: ice cubes still rattling inside after a full workout

variables.name: duration_seconds
variables.description: Total length; most models handle 5-10 seconds best

template:
A {{duration_seconds}}-second vertical 9:16 product video of {{product}} in {{setting}}.

Seconds 0-1 (hook): extreme close-up with fast push-in on {{product}} as it enters frame, instantly recognizable.
Middle: handheld medium shot of a person using it naturally; the action builds to {{key_moment}}, shown clearly in a slow-motion beat.
Final 2 seconds: static centered hero shot of the product on a clean surface, gentle light sweep across it, empty space in the top third reserved for an end-card logo added in editing.

Camera: smooth gimbal movement, shallow depth of field, 35mm look.
Lighting: warm natural key light, soft rim light on the product, realistic reflections.
Mood: energetic, authentic, premium but not glossy.
Audio: upbeat ambient sound design matching the setting, no dialogue, no voice-over.

Avoid: on-screen text, watermarks, visible brand names other than the product's own, distorted hands, flickering, morphing product shape, abrupt cuts between unrelated scenes.

example.product: a translucent orange insulated water bottle
example.setting: a sunny rooftop gym at golden hour
example.key_moment: ice cubes still rattling inside after a full workout
